blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Serving healthy food at city government events and meetings will be mandatory starting Sept. 19 following the publication of an ordinance creating a healthier food environment in the city. “With the ordinance, no public funds should be spent on unhealthy food. We expect this to have a positive impact on noncommunicable diseases in Baguio,” City Health Officer Dr. Celia Flor Brillantes said Tuesday. The ordinance, passed in March, is intended to complement other city measures addressing the rising prevalence of noncommunicable diseases. These ailments include hypertension, diabetes, chronic kidney disease, cancer and obesity among adolescents, adults and senior citizens. […]...
